description: This file defines the ImageStyle class for Drupal, representing an image style configuration entity with methods for managing image effects, URI building, cache flushing, and handling image derivatives.

classes.name: ImageStyle
classes.description: Represents an image style configuration entity with methods for managing effects, derivatives, and cache.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the ID of the image style, which is its name.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles actions after saving the entity, such as flushing old styles and updating references.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after deleting one or more image style entities.

methods.name: replaceImageStyle
methods.description: Updates entity display configurations if the image style's ID has changed.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a derivative URI for an image based on the style.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for an image derivative, with optional clean URL handling and security tokens.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Deletes derivative images or entire style directories, and clears caches.

methods.name: createDerivative
methods.description: Creates a derivative image applying effects, saving it to the specified URI.

methods.name: transformDimensions
methods.description: Applies effects to transform image dimensions.

methods.name: getDerivativeExtension
methods.description: Determines the derivative file extension based on effects.

methods.name: getPathToken
methods.description: Generates a security token for image paths.

methods.name: deleteImageEffect
methods.description: Removes a specific image effect from the style.

methods.name: supportsUri
methods.description: Checks if the style supports a given URI based on extension.

methods.name: getEffect
methods.description: Retrieves a specific image effect.

methods.name: getEffects
methods.description: Returns the collection of image effects associated with the style.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns plugin collections, specifically effects.

methods.name: addImageEffect
methods.description: Adds a new image effect to the style with a generated UUID.

methods.name: getReplacementID
methods.description: Deprecated method to get replacement style ID; triggers deprecation warning.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the image style.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the image style.

methods.name: getImageEffectPluginManager
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin manager for image effects.

methods.name: getImageFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the image factory service.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Drupal private key.

methods.name: getHashSalt
methods.description: Retrieves a salt for security purposes.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds an extension to a file path based on effects.

methods.name: fileDefaultScheme
methods.description: Returns the default file scheme ('public', 'private', etc.).

methods.name: getStreamWrapperManager
methods.description: Retrieves the stream wrapper manager service.
